chunks: It is surely the nemesis of unbelievers.

key_terms.الْکَافِرِينَ: The disbelievers, those who cover or reject the truth.
key_terms.حَسْرَةٌ: Regret, penalty, or nemesis; a state of deep loss or consequence.

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of 'hasrah' (regret/nemesis) for disbelievers in Surah Al-Qalam?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Al-Qalam (68:100) is often interpreted as the regret of the disbelievers themselves upon witnessing the reality of the truth they rejected, rather than merely God's regret. It underscores the spiritual loss incurred by those who persist in arrogance, serving as a warning that the 'penalty' is the realization of missed guidance. This concept aligns with the broader Quranic theme of 'hasrah' (regret) experienced in the Hereafter by those who ignored divine signs.
